title: Terry Lovelace's phone health data shows six stories climbed in a one-story house

tellings.quote: lel's cell phone Health Data that shows

plain: John Blitch, a scientist and podcast guest, tells about the health data on Terry Lovelace's mobile phone, Lovelace being a man who says he was abducted by non-human beings. According to Blitch, the phone recorded Lovelace climbing six flights of stairs, even though his house has only one floor. If true, it would suggest he went somewhere during that time that he does not remember.
